counting_rule: 14 component families plus 7 named compositions; seeds, scales and topologies are separate axes, not additional semantic families.

compositions.decision: Replace invalid specialist custody without discarding unaffected arrangements.
Repair overlapping amendment closures while retaining the independent track and respecting expiring rights.
Retain active suppression origins, deduplicate overlap and reactivate only actually expired cohorts.
Select feasible encodings and capacity while covering time-bounded commitments and future liabilities.
Retain accepted siblings and rework actual rejected units under maintenance and material constraints.
Reconcile changed tranches and reviewer ownership without disclosing restricted briefs or discarding valid prior dispatches.
Resolve aliases and incompatible evidence, withdraw only retracted contributions and retain unchanged source annotations.

scope_limits: Protected branches are structural controls, not claims that every task is fully connected.
Generic topology options are rejected by C09, C47 and C11 rather than silently ignored.
C25 amendment scenarios preserve their domain-specific independent track.
Skill selection correctness is not inferred from begin_skill or finish_skill labels.
World background counts and actor-observed competing evidence are reported separately.
Public rule simulations are not independent human realism validation.
